description: Use this when the user wants to add or change the questions AI answers are checked for. Adds the questions people would ask an assistant when looking for an app like this one, e.g. "best app to track PCOS symptoms". They work best in a buyer's own words, mostly without the app's name. With replace, questions not in the list stop being asked (their history is kept).
name: ai_visibility_set_questions
title: Set AI visibility questions
